challenger.name: S0_PLUS_SHRUNK_RIDER_X_CIRCUMFERENCE_OFFSET_v1
challenger.race_probability: p_i = exp(z_i) / sum_j exp(z_j) within the race
challenger.interpretation: delta_r > 0 means the rider's development evidence favors 333/333.33 relative to 400 after conditioning on frozen S0 competition_score. The sign reverses for 400 through q_c.

rider_support_rule.active_term_requires: At least one valid PRE-supported Day1 row in 333/333.33 and at least one valid PRE-supported Day1 row in 400 within the frozen development membership, exact official registration identity, and no missing competition_score.
rider_support_rule.unsupported_behavior: Explicit S0_FALLBACK: delta_r is not estimated and the row uses frozen S0 only. This is an explicit model branch, not unknown-to-zero imputation.
rider_support_rule.support_gate_distinction: The global 30-rider/60-row gate establishes adequacy for attempting the family; it does not imply every future rider is supported.

estimator.objective: Minimize development winner negative log likelihood plus L2 penalty lambda * sum_r(delta_r^2), with beta fixed.
estimator.free_parameters: One delta_r per supported rider; no intercept, no venue dummy, no beta refit.
estimator.optimization: Deterministic convex optimization to numerical tolerance 1e-10 from all-zero initialization.
estimator.lambda_selection: Choose lambda minimizing mean winner log loss in leave-one-calendar-block-out cross-validation over frozen development blocks only.
estimator.tie_rule: If mean CV log loss ties within 1e-12, choose the largest lambda (strongest shrinkage).
estimator.final_fit: After lambda selection, refit delta_r on all frozen development-fit races only. Final untouched evaluation never changes lambda or delta_r.

metrics.primary_direction: lower challenger minus S0 is better; define improvement = S0_log_loss - challenger_log_loss, so positive is better

uncertainty.method: Resample frozen evaluation races with replacement; for each replicate compute mean per-race primary improvement challenger vs S0.
uncertainty.interval: percentile 95% interval using 2.5th and 97.5th empirical percentiles
uncertainty.advancement_uncertainty_rule: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval for primary improvement must be strictly > 0

required_all: mean primary improvement > 0 on the frozen later development-evaluation block
no single venue contributes more than 60% of supported evaluation rows
no single rider contributes more than 10% of supported evaluation rows
report all negative venue/class/rider-frequency slices; none may be hidden
development_advancement.final_eval_action: If development advancement passes, keep beta/lambda/delta_r and all rules locked and evaluate once on untouched 玉野 2026-09-27 400m plus 防府 2026-09-29 333m.

missingness.competition_score_missing: Race is ineligible for challenger evaluation under this formula; do not impute zero or current values.
missingness.rider_identity_ambiguous: Fail closed for rider-specific term; no fuzzy match.
missingness.unsupported_rider: Use explicit S0_FALLBACK and report fallback fraction.

freeze_preconditions: formal support adequacy gate PASS including accepted calendar-block definition
exact development fit membership frozen PRE-only
exact later development evaluation membership frozen PRE-only
no development RESULT target joined before exact formula freeze
